Yet, the 3rd Generation Dojo will be considerably different from the first two generations, Dojo D1 and Dojo D2.Tesla describes its next-generation Dojo 3 (D3) training accelerator as a chiplet-based design that combines 2.5D and 3D packaging technologies with stacked HBM. This represents a substantial departure from the original Dojo D1 system-on-wafer architecture, which relied on distributed on-chip SRAM and interconnected 25 D1 processors with 11 GB of SRAM using wafer-scale packaging technology. The adoption of HBM suggests that Tesla intends to substantially increase memory capacity, as modern AI models consume extreme amounts of memory to store parameters, activations, and intermediate data, making SRAM unattractive from a capacity standpoint. The use of HBM simplifies memory scaling but introduces different latency, bandwidth, packaging, and power trade-offs. Yet, it remains unclear whether the company has abandoned wafer-scale integration altogether.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: On the one hand, it is possible to stack custom HBM modules on top of logic dies interconnected using wafer-scale packaging technology. On the other hand, wafer-level integration is expensive and makes the most sense for select use cases, which include SRAM-centric architectures. Stacking HBM atop wafer-scale interconnected logic dies adds further design complexities, cooling challenges, manufacturing complexity (i.e., potentially reducing yields), long-term reliability concerns, and ultimately costs. While most of the challenges can be resolved by adding redundancy and refining process technologies, this all comes at a cost, making wafer-scaling less likely for D3.Tesla has yet to disclose D3's compute performance, memory capacity, manufacturing process, or development schedule. At the same time, it claims that its Dojo D3 will be optimized for 'space, training, and scaling,' which means the unit will offer decent performance and will be easy to scale (which again points to a more conventional architecture of accelerators rather than to wafer-scale packaging). More intriguingly, the D3 is also set to be optimized for extraterrestrial deployments, which probably means radiation hardening for at least select SKUs. Depending on how HW4 performance is measured (read on for explanation), we are talking about 17,280 – 46,080 TOPS (trillion operations per second), or 17.28 – 46.08 POPS (quadrillion operations per second), though we do not know anything about data formats supported by SI6. Of course, these are estimates, so take them with a grain of salt. To put the numbers into context, Nvidia's Rubin GPU offers 50 NVFP4 PFLOPS for inference, 35 NVFP4 PFLOPS for training, and 17.5 FP8/FP6 PFLOPS. Meanwhile, Rubin is shipping to customers today, whereas SI6 is due in 2029 – 2030. There are some additional details about SI6, which we will discuss below.Tesla's existing 4th Generation inference processor used in the company's automobiles today (which was originally called HW4, then renamed to AI4, then to SI4) is made by Samsung Foundry using its 7nm-class process technology and relies on conventional flip-chip ball grid array (FCBGA) packaging (note that the alleged Tesla slide contains a mistake and claims that the unit is made using a 5nm-class node) as well as presumably 16 GB of GDDR6 memory. The company describes the processor as the current benchmark for its Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology, which makes it the baseline against which performance of future generations is measured. Meanwhile, Tesla does not officially disclose the chip's absolute compute performance numbers, memory capacity, or power consumption, which makes comparison hard. Elon Musk once said that HW4 is 3X – 8X more powerful than HW3, which was officially rated at 72 TOPS, making HW4 a 216 – 576 TOPS ASIC (note that these are estimates).Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAs expected, the slide re-confirms that the upcoming 5th Generation inference accelerator called SI5 (aka HW5 aka AI5) will be manufactured using 3nm- and 2nm-class process technologies at TSMC and Samsung Foundry, respectively, and will adopt a multi-chip module (MCM) design, marking a departure from the conventional packaging approach used for HW4. Tesla expects SI5 to deliver a 40X performance improvement over HW4, which will be a result of an eightfold increase in compute capabilities (driven by considerably denser process technologies and more execution units) and a fivefold gain from silicon optimization, according to Elon Musk, which points to 8,640 – 23,040 TOPS (an estimated figure), depending on how one counts performance of HW4. Meanwhile, the processor is expected to consume from 250W to 800W depending on application, so making performance estimates at this point is not exactly a good business. Meanwhile, the processor will also feature six times more memory than its predecessor (i.e., 96 GB). Depending on the memory type used (GDDR6 or GDDR7), the Tesla SI5 can offer memory bandwidth between 768 GB/s and 1.536 GB/s.Moving on to the Tesla's 6th Generation inference accelerator (SI6), which is set to further increase compute performance to 80 times that of HW4 and feature eight times more memory than the current-generation processor. This could translate to 17.28 – 46.08 POPS (quadrillion operations per second), depending on how to count HW4 performance, and 144 GB of memory, which is significant performance and amount of memory for an AI accelerator.Tesla has already inked a deal with Samsung Foundry to make its 6th Generation inference accelerators through 2033, and the new slide reveals that the unit will be made using a 2nm-class process technology. Given the fact that the chip is due in 2029 – 2030 and Samsung's recently updated foundry roadmap, we are probably talking about automotive-grade SF2A, performance-enhanced SF2P, or even SF2Z with backside power delivery. Meanwhile, a thing that strikes the eye with the SI6 is that Tesla does not envision the chip to be produced at Terafab using Intel's 14A fabrication process in the 2030s.SI6 will retain the multi-chip module (MCM) approach introduced with AI5/SI5/HW5, which seems rational as it will be able to leverage experience it is going to get with its 5th Generation inference accelerator and retain relatively reasonable packaging costs. Many automakers are considering adoption of multi-chiplet designs and HBM memory for their next-generation system-in-packages (SiPs), which will drive their costs. It remains to be seen when Tesla adopts HBM for its inference accelerators, but probably not with SI6. history.titleZh: 特斯拉发布AI加速器路线图，采用全新“SI”品牌推进“超级智能”布局
history.descriptionZh:
特斯拉近日公布更新后的AI加速器路线图，较系统地披露了从当前车载推理芯片到未来训练芯片的演进方向。公司将AI加速器统一改称“SI”（Super Intelligence），产品线包括已量产的SI4（即HW4/AI4）、接近量产的SI5（HW5/AI5）、开发中的SI6（AI6），以及训练芯片Dojo D1和D3。马斯克还确认SpaceXAI将更名为SpaceXSI。报道提到，这一命名变化更多是品牌和话术调整，并不改变芯片架构标准；但其路线图显示，特斯拉正从单体芯片逐步转向多芯片模块（MCM）、chiplet和HBM，应用范围也从车载推理扩展到训练甚至太空部署。

当前SI4/HW4采用三星7nm级工艺（新闻称幻灯片误写为5nm级）、FCBGA封装和约16GB GDDR6内存，内存带宽约224GB/s，是特斯拉FSD的当前性能基准。特斯拉未官方公布其绝对算力、功耗等数据；若按HW3官方72TOPS、马斯克称HW4为HW3的3至8倍推算，SI4大约为216至576TOPS。下一代SI5计划由台积电3nm级和三星2nm级工艺制造，采用MCM多芯片模块设计，内存提升至约96GB，可能使用GDDR6或GDDR7，带宽约768GB/s至1.536GB/s（原文如此，疑为TB/s笔误），功耗预计250W至800W。特斯拉称SI5相对HW4有40倍性能提升，其中约8倍来自计算能力提升、5倍来自硅片优化，推算约8,640至23,040TOPS。

SI6的目标更激进：相对HW4提升80倍算力，内存约144GB，约为SI4的9倍（文中另一处又称8倍）。按前述HW4估算口径，SI6算力约17,280至46,080TOPS，即17.28至46.08POPS。它将采用2nm级工艺和MCM设计，预计2029至2030年推出，三星已签约代工至2033年，可能使用汽车级SF2A、增强型SF2P甚至带背面供电的SF2Z工艺；报道还指出，SI6并未规划在2030年代由英特尔14A工艺的Terafab生产。作为参照，英伟达Rubin GPU已提供50 NVFP4 PFLOPS推理、35 NVFP4 PFLOPS训练和17.5 FP8/FP6 PFLOPS，且已开始交付，而SI6要晚数年，因此这些TOPS数字只能视为特斯拉的估算目标，且其支持的数据格式尚未披露，跨架构直接比较需谨慎。

训练芯片方面，Dojo D3在特斯拉2025年8月取消晶圆级Dojo项目、2026年8月又称SpaceX和xAI将主要使用英伟达硬件之后重新出现在路线图中。D3将放弃D1以SRAM为中心的晶圆级系统（SoW）架构，改为chiplet设计，结合2.5D和3D封装并堆叠HBM。D1曾采用台积电7nm、晶圆级封装，将25个D1处理器与11GB SRAM互连，单die片上SRAM为440MB，片上带宽约10TB/s，算力约362TFLOPS。D3改用HBM可显著提升内存容量，更适合大模型训练中参数、激活值和中间数据的存储需求，但也会带来延迟、带宽、封装、散热和功耗方面的新权衡。特斯拉尚未公布D3的算力、内存容量、制程和进度，只称其针对“太空、训练和扩展”优化，并可能为外星部署做抗辐射加固。由于晶圆级封装叠加HBM在成本、良率、冷却和可靠性上挑战很大，D3更可能采用较常规的chiplet加速器架构，而非继续晶圆级集成。

总体看，特斯拉自研芯片的核心影响在于：通过SI系列和Dojo D3降低对英伟达等外部AI硬件的依赖，为FSD、自动驾驶训练和未来数据中心/太空计算场景提供定制化算力。SI5和SI6若达到目标，将显著提升车载推理和数据中心训练能力，MCM与HBM方向也符合行业趋势；但其时间表较晚、成本与汽车级可靠性挑战突出，且英伟达等竞争对手迭代更快，实际竞争力仍待产品落地验证。

Members of the action group Geef Tegengas put a banner on a crane during a protest. | Image: Getty Images	

Protesters have broken into a construction site of a new Microsoft data center in Amsterdam this morning. Members of the Geef Tegengas group helped organize the protest against the construction of three 85-meter data center towers in the outskirts of Amsterdam.
Reuters reports that around 100 people made it into the construction site, with some scaling a crane to place a "fuck AI" banner. Protesters also unfurled a "Microsoft powers genocide" banner on the construction site, and chanted "Microsoft has got to go" and "free Palestine."

Read the full story at The Verge.
history.content: Protesters have broken into a construction site of a new Microsoft data center in Amsterdam this morning. Members of the Geef Tegengas group helped organize the protest against the construction of three 85-meter data center towers in the outskirts of Amsterdam.Reuters reports that around 100 people made it into the construction site, with some scaling a crane to place a “fuck AI” banner. Protesters also unfurled a “Microsoft powers genocide” banner on the construction site, and chanted “Microsoft has got to go” and “free Palestine.”Opposition to the new data center in Amsterdam comes more than a year after the city banned new data centers until 2030, after a temporary stop that was announced at the end of 2023. Microsoft will be the sole tenant of this new data center, and the project is proceeding as it was planned as far back as 2016, before a ban was put in place. The site, being built by British developer Pure Data Centres, has also managed to navigate some loopholes to reach the construction stage.RelatedMicrosoft employee disrupts 50th anniversary and calls AI boss ‘war profiteer’Microsoft employees occupy headquarters in protest of Israel contractsMicrosoft employee disrupts Satya Nadella’s keynote with ‘Free Palestine’ protestMicrosoft blocks the Israeli military from some cloud and AI servicesThe protests over Microsoft’s data center site in Amsterdam comes in the same week that activists staged a mock Israeli military checkpoint outside a Microsoft data center in Dublin on Tuesday, part of a wave of data center protests across Europe. Earlier this week, voters across the US also rejected unrestrained development of data centers. AI data centers are continuing to pop up across the US, with frequent opposition from locals concerned about the impact on their communities.Microsoft also abandoned the UK’s largest data center project last month, after local electricity grid officials said the site won’t be supplied with power until the 2030s. The software maker has also faced a wave of protests from former employees over the past year. Microsoft’s 50th anniversary party was interrupted by employees protesting the use of Microsoft’s technologies in Israel’s war against Hamas, with one calling Microsoft’s AI CEO, Mustafa Suleyman, a “war profiteer.“A Microsoft employee also disrupted the company’s Build developer conference last year, interrupting Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella’s keynote. Months later, Microsoft fired two employee protesters who occupied its president’s office.

history.titleZh: 抗议者闯入阿姆斯特丹微软数据中心工地
history.descriptionZh:
今早，约100名抗议者闯入微软位于荷兰阿姆斯特丹的一处新数据中心施工现场，反对在阿姆斯特丹郊区建设三座85米高的数据中心塔。抗议由Geef Tegengas等团体协助组织。据路透社报道，部分抗议者爬上起重机悬挂“fuck AI”横幅，并在工地展开“Microsoft powers genocide”横幅，高喊“Microsoft has got to go”和“free Palestine”等口号。事件将AI数据中心扩张、能源与土地占用、社区反对以及微软与以色列相关合同争议交织在一起。

背景方面，阿姆斯特丹在2023年底宣布临时停止后，已禁止在2030年前新建数据中心；但微软该项目的规划可追溯至2016年，早于禁令出台。微软将是该数据中心的唯一租户，项目由英国开发商Pure Data Centres建设，并通过一些漏洞推进至施工阶段。报道没有披露该数据中心的具体AI算力、芯片架构、冷却方案或能效参数，因此无法从原文获得技术原理和性能对比数据；从新闻语境看，该项目属于承载微软云与AI服务的大型数据中心基础设施，其规模以三座85米塔为标志，核心争议更多集中在选址、能源供应和伦理政治层面。

这一抗议并非孤立事件。同一周，活动人士在都柏林微软数据中心外设置模拟以色列军事检查站，构成欧洲数据中心抗议潮的一部分；本周美国选民也否决了不受限制的数据中心开发，美国各地AI数据中心持续涌现并频繁遭遇当地居民反对。微软上月还放弃了英国最大数据中心项目，原因是当地电网官员表示该站点要到2030年代才能获得供电。过去一年，微软还面临前员工抗议：公司50周年活动被员工打断，抗议微软技术被用于以色列对哈马斯的战争，有人称微软AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman为“war profiteer”；一名员工还打断了Build开发者大会上CEO Satya Nadella的主题演讲，数月后微软解雇了两名占领总裁办公室的抗议员工。

技术影响和应用场景上，AI数据中心是云计算和大模型训练推理的关键基础设施，但需要大量电力、土地和水资源，选址与供电瓶颈正成为项目落地的主要约束。阿姆斯特丹案例显示，即使城市层面设置新建禁令，早期规划项目和开发漏洞仍可能让大型数据中心推进，进而激化社区、气候与政治伦理争议。对美国与欧洲而言，AI数据中心扩张将越来越依赖电网扩容、能效提升和更透明的选址治理；对企业而言，微软等云与AI服务商需要在基础设施扩张、地方许可、能源供给和员工/公众伦理诉求之间取得平衡。

history.title: Gelsinger-backed Nagare Labs’ Z2RAM promises SRAM speed at DRAM density
history.description: Georgia Tech spinout Nagare Labs, backed by Playground Global, unveils Z2RAM, a capacitorless memory to stack on AI accelerators.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Pat Gelsinger-backed Georgia Tech spinout, Nagare Labs, says its Z2RAM can put SRAM-speed memory, at DRAM density, directly on top of AI chips. The founders’ own papers show a fast-improving cell that, tested up to 85 degrees Celsius, holds data for over 300 seconds. Gen 1 is projected to have 5x SRAM density with six stacked layers, 14x DRAM speed, and 3x less read energy than SRAM.AI chips require a lot of bandwidth, and it has been challenging to get sufficient yields of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) to feed them. Even when manufacturers can get it, some reportedly plan to settle for fewer layers for yield reasons, and heat is another. Heat is also why Samsung’s zHBM, which stacks DRAM directly on the processor, is planned at only about four layers.Alternatives include high-bandwidth flash, still in development, which stacks NAND like HBM and would sit beside the GPU, or SRAM stacked directly on the die, which is less dense and more expensive for the capacity, but also faster. DRAM, which is more capacious, can sit on top of the compute, but heat limits how hard the logic underneath can run.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: That limit is already shaping chipmakers’ design path for stacked memory. Micron’s vHBM plans, for example, include heat-spreading structures. With HBM stacked on a logic die, and DRAM needing to be kept at or below 95 degrees Celsius, the logic’s heat output is capped at 220 W/cm², or 300 W/cm² with better thermal vias, according to a 2025 simulation by co-founder Shimeng Yu’s group. Nagare Labs says peak compute has grown 70% a year over the past three decades, against 20% for memory bandwidth. (Image credit: J. Sharda et al., IEEE JxCDC (CC BY 4.0), cropped)The company describes its Z2RAM as “Two transistors and a shield. No capacitor,” where a write transistor places a charge on a storage node and the shield blocks noisy neighbors. The read transistor can sense without draining. In a gain cell like this, the read transistor’s gate capacitance holds the charge, so reads are non-destructive and the cell avoids DRAM’s write-back. Nagare aims for well under a picojoule per bit. You may like Hot Chips 2026: d-Matrix stacks AI accelerator directly on custom DRAM for 100 TB/s per card Micron details ambitious DRAM and NAND roadmap — 3D NAND, High-NA EUV, new materials, and custom silicon makes a comeback Micron's next-generation 3D NAND to double bit density with over 400 layers, offering extreme performance Nagare builds Z2RAM by depositing its layers on top of the accelerator and patterning them “together on one die,” much as 3D NAND flash scales by adding layers. There’s no interposer and no bonds between the memory layers, which is part of the secret sauce. One lithography exposure covers several layers at once, and standard 300 mm tools with DUV do the job, with no EUV required. The current roadmap is aiming at over 100 layers with “hundreds of thousands” of vertical connections.Retaining data at higher temperatures is the challenge, and one the founders have probed repeatedly with their testing. A 2020 paper from co-founder Suman Datta’s group, on a tungsten-doped indium oxide two-transistor cell, had retention of 1 second at 25 degrees Celsius and just 300 milliseconds at 85°C. An update in 2025, which has Datta as a co-author, adds a third transistor and removes the gate overlap from its transistors, managing over 1,000 seconds at 25°C, up from 200 seconds with overlapped ones. It also simulated a GPU L2 at twice SRAM’s capacity but in the same area with 75–80% lower energy-delay-area product, a combined score that multiplies energy, delay and area.Six months later, both founders showed a “folded asymmetric boosted” three-transistor cell that held data for over 300 seconds at 85°C, as compared to only 100 milliseconds for a conventional three-transistor design. That’s still below the roughly 95°C that Nagare says DRAM must stay under, so neither the founders’ published cells nor Z2RAM have shown retention above that line yet. The boosted cell is also “refresh-free,” which means data in the GPU’s last-level cache, profiled from AI workloads, doesn’t have time to decay before it is overwritten. Computers 2026 GPU L2 energy-delay-area product 75–80% lower than SRAM Simulated Twice the capacity in the same area Georgia Tech, IEDM 2025 Logic power under stacked DRAM 220 W/cm² (300 W/cm² with better thermal vias) Simulated DRAM kept at 95°C or below Yu’s group, JxCDC 2025 Nagare Gen 1 density 5× SRAM Projected Six layers, vs. 2nm HD SRAM Nagare Labs Nagare Gen 1 speed 14× faster than DRAM Projected Gen 1 Nagare Labs Nagare Gen 1 read energy 3× less than SRAM Projected Gen 1 Nagare Labs Physical space is also limited for this application, and the founders project their boosted cell at 0.0168 µm² at 7nm, compared with 0.0199 µm² for a high-density SRAM cell on TSMC’s 3nm (N3) process. A separate study from Yu’s group found that a four-tier, 256MB cache of two-transistor gain cells at 7nm could reach 5.7x the bit density of 7nm SRAM in the same area, in simulation. However, the return on investment falls off past seven or eight tiers because masks scale with layers. Nagare Labs’ claim of single lithography would potentially bypass this limitation.That has not yet been proven, and nothing published yet shows it. “Where we are is literally lab prototypes,” Datta told The Register, adding that sampling of Z2RAM tiles is targeted within four years and production shipments, if they arrive, within the next decade. Yu told the outlet that no standard yet exists for integrating this kind of memory with an accelerator, which means Nagare might have to come up with the interface itself. Datta also mentioned reliability to the outlet, as single-electron effects can shift a cell’s threshold enough to upset the stored bit. It also remains to be seen if the tested three-transistor cells work sufficiently well as a two-transistor, single-shield product. What to read next CXMT president says company’s first 4F² DRAM will be a server DDR5 RDIMM due by year-end Hot Chips 2026: High Bandwidth Flash promises massive bandwidth and capacity, but its usability is extremely limited Micron plans to use wafer bonding and High-NA EUV for next-gen DRAM Even if Nagare clears those hurdles, a more important one lingers: It currently has no fab. The plan to scale depends on getting partners for fabrication as well as packaging. Nagare is reportedly looking for an R&D fab partner so it can scale beyond the university clean room. Perhaps the most similar type of memory-on-compute shipping today, and the one Datta cited to the outlet as a model for working with chipmakers, is AMD’s 3D V-Cache.Z2RAM isn’t the first capacitorless memory to promise a 5x improvement over SRAM in density; it follows in the footsteps of Innovative Silicon’s Z-RAM from 20 years ago, a technology AMD licensed, though it was not pursued. A Georgia Tech paper due at IEDM in December covers a different device, a one-transistor, one-ferroelectric-transistor cell, aimed at the same gap between SRAM latency and DRAM density.Gelsinger, previously CEO of Intel, which started as a memory company, phased out Optane, a low-latency non-volatile memory, in favor of CXL. Optane sought to bridge the gap between slower non-volatile storage, such as HDDs and standard SSDs, and DRAM. Now he sits on Nagare’s board, and Playground Global, where he is a general partner, led the startup’s $5 million round as Nagare searches for a solution to a different but related problem.Nagare declined to share measured retention, latency, or energy figures. The founders’ boosted cell already holds data at 85°C longer than a cache needs, but until a fab-built, multi-layer Z2RAM stack is measured, retention above 95°C included, its headline numbers remain projections.

history.titleZh: 获基辛格支持的 Nagare Labs 旗下 Z2RAM 承诺以 DRAM 密度实现 SRAM 速度
history.descriptionZh:
由前英特尔CEO帕特·基辛格支持的佐治亚理工学院衍生公司Nagare Labs声称，其Z2RAM技术能够将SRAM速度的内存以DRAM的密度直接堆叠在AI芯片上方。创始人自己发表的论文显示，这种存储单元性能正在快速提升，在高达85摄氏度的测试温度下可将数据保持超过300秒。据预测，第一代产品将实现5倍于SRAM的密度（采用六层堆叠）、14倍于DRAM的速度，以及比SRAM低3倍的读取能耗。

AI芯片需要大量带宽，而获得足够良率的高带宽内存（HBM）来为其供料一直颇具挑战。即便制造商能够实现，据报道一些厂商出于良率考虑计划接受较少的堆叠层数，散热则是另一个问题。散热也是三星zHBM计划仅采用约四层堆叠的原因——该技术将DRAM直接堆叠在处理器上。替代方案包括仍在开发中的高带宽闪存，它将NAND像HBM一样堆叠并置于GPU旁边；或者将SRAM直接堆叠在裸片上，后者密度较低、单位容量成本更高，但速度更快。容量更大的DRAM可以置于计算单元上方，但散热限制了下方逻辑电路能跑多高的频率。这一限制已经在塑造芯片制造商对堆叠内存的设计路径。例如，美光的vHBM计划包含散热结构。根据联合创始人Shimeng Yu团队2025年的一项仿真研究，当HBM堆叠在逻辑裸片上、且DRAM需要保持在95摄氏度或以下时，逻辑电路的发热量被限制在220 W/cm²，若采用更好的散热通孔则可达到300 W/cm²。Nagare Labs表示，过去三十年间峰值算力每年增长70%，而内存带宽每年仅增长20%。

该公司将其Z2RAM描述为“两个晶体管加一个屏蔽层，无需电容器”——写晶体管将电荷放置在存储节点上，屏蔽层则隔绝相邻单元的噪声干扰，读晶体管可以在不消耗电荷的情况下感测数据。在这种增益单元中，读晶体管的栅极电容保持电荷，因此读取是非破坏性的，单元无需像DRAM那样进行写回操作。Nagare的目标是每比特能耗远低于1皮焦耳。

Nagare通过将各层沉积在加速器上方并在“同一裸片上一起”图案化来构建Z2RAM，这与3D NAND闪存通过增加层数来扩展的方式非常相似。内存层之间没有中介层、没有键合，这是其核心秘诀之一。一次光刻曝光可同时覆盖多个层，使用标准300毫米DUV工具即可完成，无需EUV。当前路线图的目标是超过100层，并实现“数十万”个垂直连接。

在更高温度下保持数据是核心挑战，创始人已通过反复测试对此进行了探索。2020年联合创始人Suman Datta团队发表的一篇论文，针对钨掺杂氧化铟双晶体管单元，在25摄氏度下保持时间为1秒，而在85摄氏度下仅为300毫秒。2025年的更新版本（Datta为合著者）增加了第三个晶体管并消除了晶体管的栅极重叠，在25摄氏度下实现了超过1000秒的保持时间，而重叠版本为200秒。该研究还模拟了一个容量为SRAM两倍但面积相同的GPU L2缓存，其能量-延迟-面积乘积（一个综合能耗、延迟和面积的评分指标）降低了75%至80%。六个月后，两位创始人展示了一种“折叠非对称升压”三晶体管单元，在85摄氏度下可将数据保持超过300秒，而传统三晶体管设计仅为100毫秒。这仍低于Nagare所说的DRAM必须保持在约95摄氏度以下的要求，因此创始人已发表的单元和Z2RAM都尚未展示出在该温度线以上的保持能力。该升压单元还是“免刷新”的，这意味着GPU最后一级缓存中来自AI工作负载的数据在被覆盖之前不会随时间衰减。

物理空间对该应用也构成限制。创始人在7纳米工艺下将其升压单元的面积投影为0.0168 µm²，而台积电3纳米（N3）工艺的高密度SRAM单元为0.0199 µm²。Yu团队的另一项研究发现，在仿真中，7纳米工艺下四层256MB的双晶体管增益单元缓存在相同面积下可达到7纳米SRAM位密度的5.7倍。然而，超过七八层后投资回报率会下降，因为掩膜成本随层数增加而增加。Nagare Labs声称的单次光刻技术可能绕过这一限制，但这尚未得到验证，目前也没有任何已发表成果证明这一点。

“我们目前所处的阶段就是实验室原型，”Datta对《The Register》表示，并补充说Z2RAM芯片样品的送样目标是在四年内实现，量产出货（如果能实现的话）则在未来十年内。Yu对该媒体表示，目前尚无将此类内存与加速器集成的标准，这意味着Nagare可能不得不自行开发接口。Datta还向该媒体提到了可靠性问题，因为单电子效应可能使单元的阈值偏移到足以破坏存储比特的程度。此外，已测试的三晶体管单元能否作为双晶体管单屏蔽产品足够良好地工作，仍有待观察。

即便Nagare克服了这些障碍，一个更重要的障碍依然存在：该公司目前没有晶圆厂。其扩展计划取决于能否获得制造和封装方面的合作伙伴。据报道，Nagare正在寻找研发晶圆厂合作伙伴，以便将规模扩展到大学洁净室之外。目前最接近量产的存算一体内存类型——也是Datta向该媒体提及作为与芯片制造商合作范本的——是AMD的3D V-Cache。

Z2RAM并非首个承诺密度比SRAM提升5倍的无电容内存；它追随的是20年前Innovative Silicon公司的Z-RAM技术的脚步，AMD曾授权该技术但并未继续推进。佐治亚理工学院一篇计划于12月在IEDM发表的论文涉及另一种器件——单晶体管单铁电晶体管单元，瞄准的是SRAM延迟与DRAM密度之间的同一空白。

基辛格曾任英特尔CEO，而英特尔最初是一家内存公司，后来放弃了低延迟非易失性内存Optane，转而押注CXL。Optane旨在弥合较慢的非易失性存储（如HDD和标准SSD）与DRAM之间的差距。如今基辛格担任Nagare董事会成员，他所在的General Partner公司Playground Global领投了这家初创企业500万美元的融资，而Nagare正在寻找一个不同但相关问题的解决方案。Nagare拒绝分享实测的保持时间、延迟或能耗数据。创始人已发表的升压单元在85摄氏度下保持数据的时间已超过缓存所需，但在晶圆厂制造的多层Z2RAM堆叠被实测（包括95摄氏度以上的保持能力）之前，其 headline 数据仍只是预测。

history.content: Following this week’s midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won’t use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials.Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions between developers and local officials. However, OpenAI says it is now allowing “only narrow protections covering legitimate security information, trade secrets, or proprietary or competitively sensitive information.” In October, Amazon announced it would no longer use NDAs with government agencies it works with on data center projects.RelatedData centers lost the midtermsOpenAI’s additional commitments include paying “the full cost” of electricity it uses and the “infrastructure needed to serve us.” It will make opportunities for local communities by publishing the jobs it expects to create and by reporting on hiring. And every future “compute campus” (its rebranding phrase for data centers) the company owns and operates will have a “local compact” that includes the commitments and will reflect “local priorities,” OpenAI says.

history.titleZh: OpenAI不再要求数据中心项目签署保密协议
history.descriptionZh:
在美国中期选举中选民强烈反对数据中心扩张的背景下，OpenAI宣布对其数据中心项目所在社区作出一系列新承诺，其中最受关注的是不再与公职人员签署保密协议（NDA）。此前，许多数据中心项目因依赖NDA隐藏开发商与地方官员之间的讨论而受到审查。OpenAI表示，今后与公共官员的协议仅保留“窄范围保护”，覆盖合法的安全信息、商业秘密以及专有或具有竞争敏感性的信息。这一做法与亚马逊10月的表态形成呼应：亚马逊当时宣布，不再在与政府机构合作的数据中心项目中使用NDA。相关报道亦指出，数据中心议题在中期选举中遭遇挫折。

除NDA承诺外，OpenAI还承诺支付其数据中心“全部用电成本”以及“为服务我们所需的基础设施”成本。公司将通过公布预计创造的岗位和报告招聘情况，为当地社区提供机会。OpenAI称，未来由该公司拥有并运营的每一个“计算园区”（其对数据中心的新称呼）都将制定一份“本地契约”，纳入上述承诺，并反映“当地优先事项”。

从技术与社会许可角度看，数据中心属于高耗电、强基础设施依赖型设施，其扩张不仅涉及算力部署，也涉及电网容量、能源成本和地方公共资源。OpenAI的新承诺实质上试图将电力与配套基础设施成本内部化，并通过就业透明和本地契约机制回应社区对成本转嫁、信息不透明和利益分配不均的担忧。原文未披露具体性能参数或算力指标，因此可对比的数据主要是政策层面：OpenAI与亚马逊均开始放弃对政府机构的广泛NDA，转而采用有限保密保护；OpenAI还进一步将电力成本、基础设施成本和本地就业报告纳入社区承诺。若这些承诺落地，可能推动数据中心行业提高选址与审批透明度，改善开发商与地方政府、居民之间的信任关系，并为未来算力基础设施扩张建立新的社区沟通范式。
